title: Part
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. In the first face, draw the first loop consisting of four lines. The first line starts at the origin (0.0, 0.0) and extends to (0.75, 0.0). The second line goes from (0.75, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.072). The third line moves from (0.75, 0.072) to (0.0, 0.072), and the fourth line completes the rectangle by connecting (0.0, 0.072) back to the origin. Apply a scale factor of 0.75 to the entire sketch to adjust its size. Rotate the scaled sketch using Euler angles set to zero and translate it using a vector of zeros. Extrude the sketch 0.0202 units along the normal direction to create a three-dimensional solid body. The resulting dimensions of the part are a length of 0.75 units, a width of 0.07201843671980027 units, and a height of 0.020165162281544073 units.

import cadquery as cq

# Define the sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(0.75, 0).lineTo(0.75, 0.072).lineTo(0, 0.072).close()

# Extrude the sketch
extrusion = sketch.extrude(0.0202)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = extrusion

# Create a sketch on the XY plane

     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.072) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.072) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch to create a rectangular bar
r = r.extrude(0.0202)
